story.titleZh: 安东内利领跑赞德福特练习赛，红牛未进前十
story.summaryZh: 在荷兰大奖赛唯一一次练习赛中，安德烈亚·基米·安东内利在潮湿但逐渐变干的赛道上做出最快圈速领跑，诺里斯紧随其后，而红牛车队未能进入前十。

story.originalTitle: Antonelli leads Norris in Zandvoort practice, no Red Bulls in top 10
story.summaryEn: Andrea Kimi Antonelli led the sole practice session for the Dutch Grand Prix on a damp but drying track, with Lando Norris close behind, while neither Red Bull appeared in the top 10.
detailZh: 安德烈亚·基米·安东内利在荷兰大奖赛唯一一次练习赛中领跑。
匈牙利大奖赛冠军兰多·诺里斯在赞德福特这一小时练习赛结束时，夹在两位梅赛德斯车手之间，位列第二。
练习赛开始前下雨，赛道潮湿但逐渐变干。尽管最先上场的车手使用了半雨胎，他们很快认定赛道已适合干胎。
安东内利是领先车手中第一个做出有竞争力圈速的人。梅赛德斯和法拉利车手在较硬轮胎上交替做出最快圈速。
车手们在还剩10分钟时换上软胎，以模拟排位赛。法拉利车手一度领先，随后诺里斯以微弱优势超过刘易斯·汉密尔顿。
安东内利第一次尝试排位赛模拟圈时，在圈中遇到尼科·霍肯伯格的奥迪，因而受到影响。不过他的软胎证明还能再跑一圈，这位世界锦标赛领先者随即跑进1分13秒以内，做出1分12秒949的最快圈速。
无人能与之匹敌。诺里斯也提升了自己的成绩，但最终落后安东内利0.1秒，仅以0.004秒领先另一位梅赛德斯车手乔治·拉塞尔。
接下来是两位法拉利车手，随后是另一位迈凯伦车手奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里。两辆红牛均未进入前十，马克斯·维斯塔潘受转向过度困扰，做出第11快圈速。
利亚姆·劳森回归红牛后比马克斯·维斯塔潘慢0.5秒。伊萨克·哈贾尔——劳森暂时接替了他的席位——在练习赛期间带着受伤的手腕出现在赛道。
奥迪再次展现强劲速度，尼科·霍肯伯格做出第七快圈速。他与队友之间隔着皮埃尔·加斯利，后者是本周唯一受益于阿尔派升级套件的阿尔派车手。
阿尔维德·林德布拉德位列第十，比另一位重返赛场的角田裕毅快0.9秒。本田的新动力单元帮助费尔南多·阿隆索在成绩表上位列维斯塔潘之后，排名第12。
威廉姆斯车手小卡洛斯·塞恩斯在练习赛结束时排名最慢。他三次冲出赛道：两次在汉斯·恩斯特弯，一次在13号弯。
2026年荷兰大奖赛第一次练习赛成绩
detailEn: Andrea Kimi Antonelli headed the sole practice session for the Dutch Grand Prix.
Hungarian Grand Prix winner Lando Norris split the two Mercedes drivers at the top of the times at the end of the single hour of running at Zandvoort.
Rain before the session began left the track damp but drying as the session started. Although the first drivers to join the track used intermediate tyres they quickly decided it was ready for slicks.
Antonelli was the first of the front-runners to set a competitive time. The Mercedes and Ferrari drivers exchanged the quickest times on the harder rubber.
Drivers switched to the soft tyres with 10 minutes to go in order to simulate their qualifying runs. The Ferrari drivers briefly led the way, then Norris narrowly beat Lewis Hamilton.

Antonelli’s first attempt at a qualifying run was spoiled when he encountered Nico Hulkenberg’s Audi during his lap. However his soft rubber proved capable of performing another run and the world championship leader duly dipped under the 1’13 mark, setting a best time of 1’12.949.
No one else could match that. Norris also improved his time but ended up a tenth of a second behind Antonelli, leading the other Mercedes of George Russell by a mere four thousandths of a second.
The Ferrari pair came next, followed by Oscar Piastri in the other McLaren. Neither Red Bull appeared in the top 10, Max Verstappen struggling with oversteer on his way to the 11th-fastest time.

Liam Lawson was half a second slower than Max Verstappen on his return to Red Bull. Isack Hadjar, whose seat Lawson has temporarily taken over, appeared at the track with his injured wrist during the session.

Audi showed strong pace again, Nico Hulkenberg setting the seventh fastest time. He was separated from his team mate by Pierre Gasly, who is the only Alpine driver to benefit from the team’s upgrade package this weekend.

Arvid Lindblad completed the top 10, nine-tenths of a second quicker than the returning Yuki Tsunoda in the other Racing Bulls. Honda’s new power unit helped Fernando Alonso to 12th in the times sheets behind Verstappen.
Williams driver Carlos Sainz Jnr ended the session slowest. He went off three times: twice at Hans Ernst and once at turn 13.
2026 Dutch Grand Prix first practice result
keyPointsZh: 安东内利的最快圈速为1分12秒949，诺里斯落后0.1秒，乔治·拉塞尔仅落后诺里斯0.004秒。
维斯塔潘受转向过度困扰，仅列第11位；利亚姆·劳森回归红牛后比维斯塔潘慢0.5秒。
威廉姆斯车手小卡洛斯·塞恩斯三次冲出赛道，最终排名垫底。
keyPointsEn: Antonelli's best time was 1'12.949, with Norris a tenth behind and George Russell just four thousandths behind Norris.
Verstappen struggled with oversteer and was only 11th; Liam Lawson, returning to Red Bull, was half a second slower than Verstappen.
Williams driver Carlos Sainz Jnr went off three times and ended the session slowest.

relatedItems.originalTitle: F1 United States GP: Lewis Hamilton pips Max Verstappen in FP3
detailZh: F1美国大奖赛：汉密尔顿在FP3中险胜维斯塔潘
法拉利在COTA的每节练习中都排名第一，进入排位赛
汉密尔顿在F1美国大奖赛的最后一节练习中排名第一，领先维斯塔潘和勒克莱尔进入奥斯汀的排位赛
在第三节的最后20分钟里，汉密尔顿是唯一打破1分35秒大关的车手，频繁的越界行为使得法拉利队友勒克莱尔无法超越他登上排行榜。
本节练习的前三圈只能用平淡无奇来形容，但随着汉密尔顿在软胎上跑出1分36.716秒，超越了多个使用中等轮胎的圈速。
不久后，小红牛车队和迈凯轮的利亚姆·劳森打破了汉密尔顿的成绩，而几位重量级选手仍在使用中等轮胎进行圈速测试。
尽管范斯特appen对换挡时的不稳定状态有所抱怨，但他凭借黄色侧壁轮胎的1分35.702秒成绩名列前茅。
汉密尔顿迅速提升了成绩，使用软胎跑出了1分35.561秒。但勒克莱尔尽管使用的是较慢的中胎，却以1分35.127秒的成绩接管了领先位置，这表明还有更多的速度可以挖掘。
进入最后20分钟，安东内利在软胎上比勒克莱尔快了十分之一，但他在9号弯道超出了赛道限制，导致这一圈被取消。
维斯塔潘遵守了白线，以1分35.061秒的成绩排名第一，红牛车队在第一区段是最快的，但汉密尔顿的成绩低于1分35秒，达到了1分34.893秒。
在整个练习过程中一直出现的赛道限制问题，也阻止了勒克莱尔重新夺回第一的位置，因为他在10号弯道越过了白线。
这意味着摩纳哥车手只能满足于排在汉密尔顿和维斯塔潘之后，为周六下午的排位赛设置了一场紧张激烈的局面。
冠军车手安东内利排在第四位，领先于梅赛德斯车队的队友乔治·拉塞尔，银箭车队似乎在纯速度上落后半步，皮亚斯蒂在难以驾驭的MCL40中排在第六位。
在奥迪车队，尼科·胡肯伯格阻止了麦克拉伦车队的兰多·诺里斯获得第七名，世界冠军的1分35.2秒成绩也因为第十弯的赛道限制而被取消。
阿尔派车队的皮埃尔·加斯利排在第九位，落后汉密尔顿一秒，伊萨克·哈德贾在第二辆小红牛车队中排在第十位，这位法国车手因为他的赛车操控问题而感到沮丧。
detailEn: F1 United States GP: Lewis Hamilton pips Max Verstappen in FP3
Ferrari heads into qualifying having topped every practice session at COTA
Lewis Hamilton finished final practice on top at Formula 1's United States Grand Prix, leading Max Verstappen and Charles Leclerc into qualifying at Austin.

Hamilton was the only driver to break the 1m35s barrier in the final 20 minutes of third practice, as frequent track limits transgressions kept Ferrari team-mate Leclerc from leapfrogging him on the leaderboard.
Following an opening quarter of the session which can only be described as pedestrian, action picked up as Hamilton set a 1m36.716s on softs to get ahead of a number of medium-tyred install laps.
His time was soon beaten by Liam Lawson in the Racing Bulls and McLaren's Oscar Piastri, while several heavy hitters kept turning laps on medium tyres instead.
Verstappen even went top courtesy of a 1m35.702s on the yellow sidewall tyre, despite recurring complaints about his unsettling downshifts.

Hamilton swiftly improved upon the Dutchman's lap, using softs to set a 1m35.561s. But when Leclerc took over command with a 1m35.127s despite using the slower mediums, that underlined there was still a lot more pace to find.
Entering the final 20 minutes, Antonelli took a tenth out of Leclerc's time on softs, but his lap was scratched for breaking track limits at Turn 9.
Verstappen did adhere to the white lines to set a 1m35.061s and go top, with Red Bull the quickest car through sector one, only for Hamilton to dip below the 1m35s barrier with a 1m34.893s.
Track limits, which have been a recurring theme throughout practice, also kept Leclerc from reclaiming first as he dipped over the white line at Turn 10.
That meant the Monegasque had to settle for third behind Hamilton and Verstappen, setting up a finely poised qualifying session on Saturday afternoon.

Championship leader Antonelli was fourth ahead of Mercedes team-mate George Russell, as the Silver Arrows appears to be a half-step behind on pure pace, with Piastri sixth in the difficult to tame MCL40.
In the Audi, Nico Hulkenberg kept McLaren’s Lando Norris from seventh, with the world champion’s 1m35.2s also deleted for track limits at Turn 10.
Alpine driver Pierre Gasly was ninth, a full second behind Hamilton, with Isack Hadjar 10th in the second Red Bull as the Frenchman was left frustrated by his car's handling.
keyPointsZh: 勒克莱尔因越界无法超越汉密尔顿
keyPointsEn: Leclerc could not overtake Hamilton due to track limits transgressions
